reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Bukatalks talk about Bukalapak customer-service satisfaction and customer experience. It describes Buka Bantuan as support for buyers and sellers and shows ordinary app and support branding. The 10% figure is discussed as a possible business result of customer satisfaction, not as an investment return or a request for money, credentials, or paid participation.

citations.quote: Customer Service Satisfaction in Bukalapak | Bukatalks
Let's talk about service, old service, now in said that the service in the old-time is like hotel service.
Our customers are Gaptek. We've prepared call center. Those who like chatting, we have chat as well. And for those who want to take e-mail, then it would be responded.
every day, Bukalapak's Buka Bantuan team are all ready to help buyers and sellers and anyone at anytime
our responsive Buka Bantuan team, who are well-involved and ready to help you 24 hours a day

opening.argument: The presentation links an easy commercial outcome to a prescribed action: viewers are told that sales can rise “up to 10%” merely by creating customer satisfaction, and later that revenue improvement is “easy, just satisfied our customers.” The proposed mechanism is then operationalized through contact channels, customer data, and support interactions. That combination makes this more than neutral discussion: it presents a low-effort path to increased returns through participation in the promoted service ecosystem. The video also closes with a direct app and assistance pathway, making the promised commercial benefit actionable rather than purely theoretical.

citations.quote: how to increase sales up to 10% is very easy, only by creating customer service satisfaction
Then with the data, we make the customer satisfied, it'll increase by 10%
It's easy, just satisfied our customers
every day, Bukalapak's Buka Bantuan team are all ready to help buyers and sellers and anyone at anytime

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a talk does not remove its solicitation function. The title and support language establish a promotional setting, while the central claim still promises a concrete sales increase from a simple behavioral change. The support channels are not merely background information: they are the means by which users are invited to enter the service relationship. Describing the result as a possible business outcome does not explain the unusually simple “up to 10%” framing.

citations.quote: how to increase sales up to 10% is very easy
What will happen in three months Then the transaction increase by 10%
You can create account through Twitter, or PostMet or emails

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument converts an internal business claim into a viewer-facing reward, but the material does not promise viewers cash, assets, withdrawals, or payment for taking an action. “Increase sales” is presented as a company objective tied to customer service, not as a guaranteed personal return. The support material describes ways to contact Bukalapak, and the closing identifies assistance for buyers and sellers, not a claim or verification flow.

citations.quote: Then the transaction increase by 10%
we need something what give more, so you can enjoy and stay with us and increase transaction
Buka Bantuan team are all ready to help buyers and sellers

opening.argument: Several unusually strong signals appear together: an “up to 10%” increase is described as very easy, satisfaction is treated as sufficient to increase revenue, and the service advertises an exceptional response metric. The presentation repeatedly turns customer support into a growth formula, including the claim that satisfaction will increase transactions by 10%. It also supplies numerous online contact and app pathways. Even without an explicit payment request, this combination of easy gains, numerical performance claims, and multiple conversion channels can make ordinary support branding function as a deceptive acquisition pitch.

citations.quote: how to increase sales up to 10% is very easy
96% total ticket has been answered within 15 minutes
Then with the data, we make the customer satisfied, it'll increase by 10%
Download the Bukalapak application here

rebuttal.rebuttal: The ordinary setting is precisely what makes the pitch persuasive: a branded talk can make performance claims appear authoritative while presenting them as easy and measurable. The response-time statistic and repeated 10% figure are used to build confidence, not independently substantiated. The existence of support channels does not neutralize the pressure created by promising growth through a simple formula.

citations.quote: Our response time is amazing.. ...96% total ticket has been answered within 15 minutes...
So, when we did this all at once, it was easy
Download the Bukalapak application here

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are business-performance and service-quality claims, not scam-specific inducements. The 10% statement concerns sales or transactions, while the 96% statement concerns tickets answered within 15 minutes; neither promises a viewer a reward for depositing, buying, recruiting, or paying. The supplied material also identifies the content as a customer-service discussion and describes assistance for users.

Then the transaction increase by 10%

ready to help buyers and sellers and anyone at anytime

opening.argument: Although packaged as an educational discussion, the material operates as direct promotion for Bukalapak's service and app. The description emphasizes Bukalapak's commitment, provides subscription and website links, and tells viewers to download the application. The talk then presents Bukalapak's support infrastructure as a way to increase transactions and revenue, while the closing branding displays the app stores and Buka Bantuan contact. This is not detached analysis: it steers viewers toward a branded service while pairing participation with an attractive growth narrative.

citations.quote: what Bukalapak is done as a form of commitment to its customers
Download the Bukalapak application here
so you can enjoy and stay with us and increase transaction

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational label is not enough when the surrounding material repeatedly directs attention to the company's own channels and application. The speaker does not merely explain customer-service theory; she describes how Bukalapak can retain customers and increase revenue. The branded closing reinforces that the practical endpoint is engagement with the promoted platform.

citations.quote: Bukatalks is an initiative from Bukalapak to build a forum for creators and innovators
I want to be rich in my company by asking our customers to stay
If you're happy, you will stay and increase revenue

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of an ordinary commercial service is not itself a scam. The description openly identifies Bukatalks as a Bukalapak initiative, and the video discusses customer experience and support rather than disguising a financial scheme. The app links and branding identify the provider; they do not establish a hidden reward, fee, investment, or deceptive participation requirement.
